customer_concentration.note: FY2026 10-K: no channel partner or direct customer >=10% of revenue in FY24-FY26

notes: Fiscal year ends Jan 31 (FQ2'27 = quarter ended 2026-07-31). Revenue is from XBRL; FQ4 values are FY minus 9M. Subscription revenue is 95% of the total. Gross margin is total non-GAAP: (subscription 1,136.1 + services 21.1) / 1,470.9 = 78.7% (subscription only 81%). TTM (FQ3'26-FQ2'27): OCF 2,016.6, capex 491.0 (PP&E + capitalized internal-use software), FCF 1,525.6 on revenue 5,396.1. Net cash = cash 5,013.8 - senior notes carrying 746.2 at 7/31/26; operating leases excluded. NRR: the Q2 release and 10-Q say dollar-based gross and net retention 'increased' but give no number, so null. 4-for-1 stock split effective 2026-07-01: pre-split non-GAAP EPS was divided by 4. TTM non-GAAP EPS 0.24+0.28+0.275+0.31=1.105 vs 0.19+0.2025+0.1825+0.23=0.805. Price $270.04 (post-split) at the 2026-10-02 close. July 19, 2024 incident litigation is still pending (10-Q FQ2'27; the airline-passenger class action is on appeal). Not flagged because the company does not describe it as material.
